review.headline: Long run 16 km completed at a steady, controlled 5:47/km, squarely inside the easy band.
observations: Distance 15.995 km in 5550 s moving time (5:47/km), within the planned 5:11-6:13/km easy range.
Remarkably even pacing: 15 of 16 km splits at 5:48/km, with HR 140-144 throughout, so no drift or fade.
Average HR 142 bpm, max 145 bpm, consistent with a relaxed aerobic effort and matching the prior easy run HR of 138-140.
The run fits the brief of steady and unhurried; the single 5:38 split at km 9 is negligible noise.
flags: No RPE or athlete note was logged, so subjective effort and fueling cannot be confirmed.
Elevation gain of 182 m is not reflected in the planned session; worth noting for future long-run pacing.
Week 1 completed only 4 of 7 sessions and no strength or cross-training was logged, so the week's load is incomplete.
